parameters.value: A high-temperature device that heats materials in an enclosed chamber, isolating them from direct contact with heating elements to ensure clean and precise sintering.

A robust outer steel casing, ceramic or refractory muffle chamber, embedded high-temperature heating elements, thermal insulation, secure door seals, temperature controllers, and exhaust systems for safe and uniform heating of samples.
Kanthal (Iron-Chromium-Aluminum alloy), Nichrome (Nickel-Chromium alloy), Silicon Carbide (SiC) rods, Molybdenum Disilicide (MoSi?) rod, Magnetron
Natural cooling, Forced air cooling, Water cooling

Description of Instrument: A high-temperature device that heats materials in an enclosed chamber, isolating them from direct contact with heating elements to ensure clean and precise sintering. | Construction: A robust outer steel casing, ceramic or refractory muffle chamber, embedded high-temperature heating elements, thermal insulation, secure door seals, temperature controllers, and exhaust systems for safe and uniform heating of samples. | Operational Technology: Heating Element, Microwave | Loading Configuration: Front Loading | Chamber Volume in Litres (L): 6 L, 15 L | Working Temperature in Degree Celsius (°C): 0 to 1200°C | Temperature Control: Microprocessor Based PID | Temperature Accuracy in Degree Celsius (°C): ± 2°C | Heating element: Kanthal (Iron-Chromium-Aluminum alloy), Nichrome (Nickel-Chromium alloy), Silicon Carbide (SiC) rods, Molybdenum Disilicide (MoSi?) rod, Magnetron | Chamber Construction: Triple walled with air insulation | Insulation: Ceramic fibre | Material of the outer body: Mild Steel duly powder coated | Communication Port: RS 485
Temperature Sensor: Thermocouples | Cooling: Natural cooling, Forced air cooling, Water cooling | Power Supply: 230V ± 10%, Single Phase AC Supply
